summary: A horizontal or vertical divider, plain, or with a clickable icon or a text label in the middle.

props.name: orientation
props.description: A vertical rule for a row layout, like a button group. Ignored alongside `icon` or `label`, which are a horizontal-only pattern.

props.name: icon
props.description: Renders as a clickable button in the middle, sized & shaped to match. Wins over `label` if both are set.

props.name: onIconClick
props.description: Called when the icon button is pressed.

props.name: label
props.description: Renders as plain text in the middle. Ignored if `icon` is set.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius on the icon button. Only visible alongside `icon`.

props.name: className
props.description: Appended to the separator's (or wrapper's, when `icon`/`label` is set) classes, so any Yumma CSS utility you pass wins.
